findings.problem: The guide declares the immutable matrix exhaustive for every post-acquisition or repeated-execute public result, but TC-03 deliberately produces post-acquisition Workspace/resource/execution-authority, capability/binding/policy selector, reference-integrity, trusted-store and key-lifecycle denials that are not represented in that matrix. The only stated legacy-error-envelope exception is for pre-acquisition failures. TC-10 consequently verifies only success, the three provider rejections, indeterminate, current in-progress, provider conflict and fenced rows, leaving the TC-03 post-acquisition denial serialization, HTTP status and exact public field set unspecified. A conforming implementation could therefore expose different public projections for those rows while still satisfying the written TC-03 and TC-10 oracles. This leaves M4-77-GR-007 not fully closed.
findings.required_change: Extend the immutable independently sourced public-result contract and TC-10 coverage to every TC-03 post-acquisition denial row, defining its exact application result, HTTP status, complete allowed field set/value domains and forbidden fields; alternatively, if those rows intentionally use an existing error envelope rather than the result matrix, explicitly classify every such post-acquisition row into that envelope and lock its exact code/status/field shape in the independent fixture and TC-10 comparison.

summary: The guide provides deterministic coverage for authorization/staleness, atomic acquisition, post-lock authority and m4r1 rechecks, PostgreSQL-time linearization, durable admission, admission-first dispatch, SQLite provider atomicity and cross-binding, crash uncertainty, the #77/#78 recovery boundary, fencing, audit reconstruction, production DI isolation, static typed registry constraints and release verification. The v3 changes close the exact post-acquisition non-key denial oracle, provider cross-binding ordering/zero-mutation oracle and production test-only signer/mutator isolation findings. However, the claimed exhaustive immutable public-result matrix omits the post-acquisition denial outcomes exercised by TC-03, so AC-09 and prior finding M4-77-GR-007 remain unresolved.
